identity.title: An efficient targeted nuclease strategy for high-resolution mapping of DNA binding sites.

evidence.passage: specific protein-DNA complexes into the supernatant for paired-end DNA sequencing

screening.reader: engineering scientific intake audit; provisional judgments

sequence_based_measurement.rationale: Released target-associated DNA is read by paired-end sequencing.

assay_workflow_contribution.rationale: The paper introduces targeted in situ nuclease release as a chromatin measurement workflow.

experimental_demonstration.rationale: The primary abstract reports assays in yeast and human nuclei.

identity.title: Chromatin Potential Identified by Shared Single-Cell Profiling of RNA and Chromatin

evidence.passage: Here we developed simultaneous high-throughput ATAC and RNA expression with sequencing (SHARE-seq)

screening.reader: engineering scientific intake audit; provisional judgments
screening.rationale: Positive control against rejecting application-sounding titles. Computational chromatin potential is a distinct analysis claim.

sequence_based_measurement.rationale: Joint accessibility and RNA measurements are obtained by sequencing.

assay_workflow_contribution.rationale: The abstract explicitly develops a same-cell joint measurement assay despite a biological/computational title.

experimental_demonstration.rationale: Mouse-skin joint profiles are experimental assay evidence.

identity.title: Improved genome sequencing using an engineered transposase

evidence.passage: a mutant transposase (Tn5-059) with a lowered GC insertion bias

evidence.section: Methods: DNA library preparation, sequencing and data analysis
evidence.passage: using the standard Nextera DNA library preparation method
evidence.locator: Methods: DNA library preparation, sequencing and data analysis

screening.reader: engineering scientific intake audit; provisional judgments
screening.rationale: Retain Tn5-059 as component evidence with bias/interface implications. Reconsider if a distinct assay-level protocol contribution is subsequently established; reagent words alone do not exclude.

sequence_based_measurement.rationale: Sequencing tests quantify the effect on genome coverage.

assay_workflow_contribution.rationale: The inspected Methods use the existing Nextera library workflow; the scoped contribution established here is the enzyme variant and performance, not a separately defined assay protocol.

experimental_demonstration.rationale: The abstract reports empirical bacterial/human sequencing comparisons.

identity.title: chromVAR: inferring transcription-factor-associated accessibility from single-cell epigenomic data

evidence.passage: We developed chromVAR, an R package for analyzing sparse chromatin accessibility data

screening.reader: engineering scientific intake audit; provisional judgments
screening.rationale: Context/software dependency, not a new experimental assay entry. Initial search observed the primary abstract; subsequent full-page fetch returned a browser challenge.

sequence_based_measurement.rationale: Its new contribution analyzes pre-existing accessibility data; it does not create a physical sequence-based measurement workflow.

assay_workflow_contribution.rationale: The contribution is an analysis package rather than an experimental assay change.

experimental_demonstration.rationale: The short abstract observation supports software evaluation; it does not establish a new wet-lab assay demonstration.

identity.title: The cis-regulatory atlas of the mouse immune system

evidence.passage: We generated matched epigenome and transcriptome measurements in 86 primary cell-types

screening.reader: engineering scientific intake audit; provisional judgments
screening.rationale: Application/resource control. A paper contributing a biological atlas does not become an assay entry from its data scale.

sequence_based_measurement.rationale: Matched epigenome/transcriptome data use established sequencing assays.

assay_workflow_contribution.rationale: The inspected abstract describes a biological resource; focused source text identifies existing fast-ATAC and low-input RNA-seq, not a newly introduced assay.

identity.title: Tn5 transposase and tagmentation procedures for massively scaled sequencing projects

evidence.passage: procedures for Tn5 transposase production and optimized reaction conditions for tagmentation-based sequencing library construction

screening.reader: engineering scientific intake audit; provisional judgments
screening.rationale: Borderline older paper retained for focused review rather than rejected as a reagent paper. It is not yet a verified missing predecessor.

sequence_based_measurement.rationale: The abstract concerns constructing sequencing libraries.

assay_workflow_contribution.rationale: Protein production is component work, but crowding/reaction conditions can establish a real low-input library workflow improvement. Needs a scoped protocol and version comparison.

experimental_demonstration.rationale: The abstract reports single-cell library comparisons and low-input tagmentation.

screening.focused_review_question: Do the crowding and reaction changes define a distinct demonstrated low-input assay implementation missing from the registry, or are they supporting component procedures for an existing method?
focused_review_targets: Compare assigned Nextera/Smart-seq2 publications and existing component registrations
